simHistory.content: Oh, hey there! Good to hear from you. I was just about to reach out actually. About that invoice... I'm so sorry, but we've had a bit of a snag with our accounting department this week. Our main finance person is out sick, and things are just a bit backed up. I'm sure it'll be sorted soon, but it might take a few extra days.

No? What do you mean 'no'? I just explained the situation. Our finance person is genuinely out sick, and we can't process payments without them. It's completely out of my hands right now. I'm just asking for a little understanding and a few more days until they're back.
Mock: That looks good, but can we just add one more page for the same price? It should be super simple for you!
